questions.statement: The main purpose of the text is to

options.text: argue that slowing the economic growth will definitely cause inflation to take root.
indicate that inflation is a serious problem, and it needs to be adequately dealt with.
suggest that restoring price stability will certainly increase inflation.
show that controlling inflation is a minor concern, compared to unemployment.
inform that the U.S. central bank’s monetary policy has already decreased inflation to 2%.

questions.explanation: O objetivo indicado é mostrar a inflação como problema relevante que precisa ser enfrentado adequadamente. As demais formulações distorcem a discussão ao apresentar efeitos certos, inverter a relação com a estabilidade de preços ou minimizar o problema sem base textual.
